# HexPiece 3.4.6

Your corrections to the Nika fruit. Not tested in game yet: the build and all tests pass, and Dawn Whip was rendered with its leg, third
and first person (a preview, not the game).

**Gear 5 only, as you said**
- Goof Ball (C) only works in Gear 5. Untransformed, C does nothing (the old plain whip is gone).
- Giant (B) only works in Gear 5 too. Untransformed, B does nothing.
- The panel shows both dimmed with "Gear 5" while you are untransformed, and the Ability Book says so.
- Dawn Whip stays Haki-only: Gear 5 with Armament or Ryou on. Without Haki in Gear 5, C is always Goof Ball.

**Dawn Whip: the leg**
- The striking leg is now drawn by the mod itself, so what you saw in the render is what the game draws: your right leg, in your
  Gear 5 skin, coated dark by Haki with a violet glow along its outline, stretched from your hip out to about 10 blocks.
- It shoots out as you unwind, whips round with your body (bending back like a whip the faster it turns), sweeps across what is in
  front of you at the impact, and pulls back in as you spin on. The smear follows the leg exactly.
- In first person you see the leg sweep out from under you and across your view.

Not tested in game: all of the above.
